newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory coast - Feb 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory coast - Feb 7.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Government expels managing director of Barclay's Bank in Ivory Coast accusing him of humiliating Ivorian staff; letter from Employment and Civil Service Minister Achi Atsain says Vandeker Khove's behaviour recalled colonial practices in Africa and adds that this was unacceptable for Ivory Coast and its government.
- Air Afrique and Air France slash prices on flights to France (advertisement)
- Police use tear gas to break up student meeting; leader of student federation FESCI detained in Abidjan's MACA prison.
- Student federation FESCI calls five day strike from February 11 after arrest of its leader
- Abidjan port invites tenders for container gantry for its Vridi terminal; closing date for tenders March 27
